body.name: Full-data restrictions and profiled observable restrictions
body.construction: For each \(x\in\mathcal X\), set \(q_{\mathrm{PT},x}(P)=\delta_1^0(x)\mathbf 1_J-D(x)\in\mathbb R^J\), whose \(j\)-th coordinate is the treated-versus-donor \(j+1\) untreated final-change equality, and set \(q_{\mathrm{SC},x}(P)=\{I_T-B(x)[B(x)^{\prime}B(x)]^{-1}B(x)^{\prime}\}a(x)\in\mathbb R^T\). Profiling the unrestricted counterfactual scalar \(\delta_1^0(x)\) gives \(r_{\mathrm{PT},x}(P_O)=A_{\mathrm{PT}}q_{\mathrm{PT},x}(P)=-A_{\mathrm{PT}}D(x)\), while \(r_{\mathrm{SC},x}(P_O)=q_{\mathrm{SC},x}(P)\). Thus the raw PT map has \(J\) treated-versus-donor coordinates and its observed-data derivative has rank \(J-1\).
